content.text: In regions like Nigeria and Venezuela, where traditional [[LINK:https://[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-honest-side-side-9|COREMERCH guide to coremerch]].github.io/store/blog/why-payment-methods-filipino-digital-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-honest-side|How Creators]]-costing-you-3|payment]] platforms like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable or severely restricted, digital creators face significant challenges in setting up online stores. COREMERCH offers a solution that bypasses these limitations. Utilizing Supabase as your order database, you can create a robust digital store that accepts crypto payments without relying on conventional platforms. This guide walks you through deploying your store with Stack 01 and Stack 02, ensuring that you can operate effectively and independently.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The reliance on conventional payment platforms often leads to significant operational barriers for digital creators in regions facing financial isolation. COREMERCH's infrastructure empowers you to take control of your commerce by leveraging platforms like Supabase and NOWPayments. This design ensures that you own all the data and processes involved in your transactions, circumventing the obstacles posed by payment platform restrictions. By utilizing decentralized payment methods, you maintain sovereignty over your digital commerce operations, allowing for seamless transactions and product delivery.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, gather the necessary resources and tools. For Stack 01, ensure you have a GitHub account for hosting, a Google account for Apps Script, and an active NOWPayments account for crypto processing. Create a Supabase project for database management, and prepare your digital products for upload. Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint, as it provides detailed instructions for a successful deployment. This preparation phase is crucial for a smooth setup process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by deploying your backend using GitHub Pages and integrating Google Apps Script. Set up your Supabase database to manage orders efficiently. Next, configure NOWPayments for automatic payment processing, ensuring that you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. This pipeline not only automates payment verification but also facilitates instant delivery of your digital products. Test each component individually to ensure seamless integration before moving to the next deployment step.
Embrace infrastructure sovereignty with full data ownership.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it’s time to go live. Promote your digital store and direct potential customers to your GitHub Pages URL. Monitor the performance of your payment processing through NOWPayments as customers make transactions. Ensure that product delivery is automated and that you can track orders through your Supabase database. Initial transactions are critical; analyze your setup in real-time to identify any issues that may arise during the first sales.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing initial transactions, consider scaling your operations. Expand your product offerings by adding more digital products to your Supabase database. Leverage the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for enhanced performance and support. Implement promotional strategies to increase visibility and sales. Utilize feedback from early customers to refine your store’s design and functionality. Your infrastructure is now capable of handling increased traffic, allowing for sustainable growth without reliance on external platforms.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, leverage COREMERCH's Stack 01 or Stack 02. Stack 01 allows you to deploy using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, while Stack 02 employs Cloudflare Pages and Supabase. Both options ensure you maintain sovereignty over your commerce infrastructure without hidden fees or dependencies.
Automate your payment processing with NOWPayments for efficiency.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

You can build a digital store by using COREMERCH's Stack 01 or Stack 02. Stack 01 involves deploying on GitHub Pages with Google Apps Script and NOWPayments. Stack 02 utilizes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase for a more robust solution.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 is a simpler setup using GitHub Pages and Apps Script, taking 4-6 hours for deployment. Stack 02 is more comprehensive, utilizing Cloudflare Pages and Supabase, and is deployed in 48 hours, fully end-to-end tested.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are excellent hosting options for digital product stores. They provide robust infrastructure and allow for seamless integration with crypto payment processing.
What are the benefits of using Supabase as an order database?

Supabase offers a powerful and user-friendly database solution for managing orders. It provides real-time capabilities, easy integration with your frontend, and ensures you maintain complete ownership of your data.
How does NOWPayments integrate with my digital store?

NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee. Integration is straightforward and automates payment verification, facilitating instant product delivery once transactions are confirmed.
